assumptions: a07_moves_per_game_80 (planning arithmetic only; no measured bytes/row is claimed here)
The 1 TiB group free-space floor is a design choice, not a measurement: it is 2x the mission's whole 500 GiB budget, so spending the entire budget can never be what fills the shared 40 TB pool.

quotas.py reports DECIMAL TB (40.00 TB matches the 40000000000000 B pool df reports), and is rounded to 0.01 TB and refreshed hourly; the guard takes min(quotas.py, df -B1) so neither rounding nor staleness can hide a shortage.
